swap_submitted_without_deadline.meaning: user submitted a swap transaction to the Router without any deadline parameter

tx_delayed_in_mempool.meaning: the submitted transaction was held by a validator or remained in the mempool for an extended period

market_conditions_changed.meaning: market conditions changed unfavorably for the user before the delayed transaction would execute

unwanted_trade_occurred.meaning: the user suffered an unwanted trade as a result of execution at an unexpected time

claims.scope: Router/Core swap transaction execution without a user-specified deadline

preconditions.text: A user submits a swap transaction to the Router without any deadline parameter, since the Router and Core do not allow users to specify one.; The submitted transaction can be held by a validator or remain in the mempool for an extended period.; Market conditions have changed unfavorably for the user by the time the delayed transaction would execute.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A swap transaction should not be executable after a significant delay; users should be able to bound execution time via a deadline so stale transactions cannot execute under changed market conditions.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Users may suffer unwanted trades as a result of execution at unexpected times.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The Router and Core contracts do not allow users to specify a deadline, so the submitted swap carries no execution-time bound.
The delayed transaction would execute under the changed market conditions described.

limitations: The temporal bound is qualitative; no concrete deadline or delay constant is stated in the report.
The claim formalizes only the unwanted_trades impact; loss_of_opportunity and unexpected_time_execution are handled in separate passes.
